description: This file contains functions for fixing up and transforming ONNX control flow nodes (Loop and If) within the Torch JIT graph, including handling sequence dependencies, shape/type inference, and control flow adjustments for ONNX export.

methods.name: CreateCastToBoolNode
methods.description: Creates a Cast node to convert a tensor to boolean type for ONNX control flow conditions.

methods.name: InsertCastForCond
methods.description: Inserts a cast node before a control flow node to ensure condition tensor is of boolean type.

methods.name: IsCondCastRequired
methods.description: Checks if a condition value needs to be cast to boolean for ONNX control flow.

methods.name: IsErasableSequence
methods.description: Determines if a sequence in a loop can be erased and converted to scan outputs.

methods.name: ConvertSequenceDependencies
methods.description: Converts sequence dependencies in ONNX Loop nodes to scan outputs for compatibility.

methods.name: ONNXOptionalNode
methods.description: Creates an ONNX Optional node with specified type.

methods.name: ReplaceBlockOutputWithOptional
methods.description: Replaces a block output with an ONNX Optional node to handle optional types.

methods.name: FixupONNXSubblockOutputs
methods.description: Fixes subblock outputs in control flow nodes to address ONNX limitations.

methods.name: FixupONNXLoopBlockInputs
methods.description: Infers and fixes input types of loop subblocks for ONNX export.

methods.name: FixupONNXLoopBlockOutputs
methods.description: Fixes and infers output types of loop subblocks for ONNX export.

methods.name: FixupONNXLoopNode
methods.description: Performs fixup transformations on ONNX Loop nodes, including sequence conversion and shape inference.

methods.name: IsUninitializedNode
methods.description: Checks if a node is an uninitialized or identity of an uninitialized node.

methods.name: InferShapeTypeForUninitializedOutput
methods.description: Infers shape and type for uninitialized outputs based on other subblock outputs.

methods.name: ONNXFixupUninitializedOutput
methods.description: Fixes and infers shape/type for uninitialized outputs in control flow nodes.

methods.name: ONNXMergeIfBlockOutputShapes
methods.description: Merges output shapes and types of if-then and else blocks to ensure consistency.

methods.name: FixupONNXIfNode
methods.description: Performs fixup transformations on ONNX If nodes, including shape/type inference and uninitialized handling.
